test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**
Swami tried to get away from** his homework by making excuses.
solution:
The correct answer is '**3**' i.e. 'Get out of'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The phrase "**get out of**" is used to indicate avoiding doing something, often by making excuses.
 
• The context of the sentence suggests that Swami is trying to avoid doing his homework, which aligns with the meaning of "**get out of**."
 
• **Option 1:** "Get along" refers to having a friendly relationship and is irrelevant in this context.
 
• **Option 2:** "Get over" means to recover from something, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 4:** "Get through" means to complete or endure something, which is incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Swami tried to get out of his homework by making excuses."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Get out of:** Commonly used to describe avoiding responsibilities or tasks by making excuses.
 
• **Example:** He always tries to get out of doing the dishes by pretending to be busy.
